column1: # Clear paths, one line per area of each map, measured by map_size.py (kept out of the repo) on 2026-10-28
# from <Diablo II>\ProjectD2's layouts (nothing measured in game). path: the length in tiles of a greedy walk
# that brings 95% of the area's reachable spawn spots within 15 subtiles of the player along the ground
# (8 directions, no corner cutting), from where it stands toward the nearest spot not yet seen; the average
# of every layout file and five starts (the corners of the walkable region and its middle); an area of
# several walkable regions joined by portals (the Outer Void) one walk per region. full: the same to see
# every spot. Most players clear 90-95% of a map (the author, 2026-10-28). tools/gen_map_exp.py divides the
# experience line by a map's path (its areas added).
